top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a transparent analytical prediction (Bistritzer-MacDonald: interlayer tunnelling flattens the bands at a discrete magic angle) followed by a decisive experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states at that angle, reproduced by independent groups; the organising mechanism is understood at the single-particle level. The citation can be scoped to the prediction and observed phases without implying an explanation of the pairing, though the three-name cap leaves Cao, Fatemi and Dean uncredited. P001 is a very strong, cleanly credited second, but it refines a measurement programme already honoured in 2005 and 2012. P004 adds a weakly credited single-name IceCube part to the clock; P003 is more an enabling technique with a narrower physics discovery; no award is least preferred since several mature candidates exist.
